en.headline: Hong Kong ends Asian Games with 11 golds and 54 medals
en.dek: The delegation finished with 11 gold, 19 silver and 24 bronze, its best gold and medal totals at an Asian Games, RTHK reported.
body: Hong Kong's Asian Games campaign closed on Sunday with 11 gold, 19 silver and 24 bronze medals, 54 in all, RTHK reported. Both the gold count and the overall medal total were the city's best at an Asian Games.

RTHK said the Games produced several firsts for the delegation. Coleman Wong took the men's singles tennis title, Hong Kong's first Asian Games gold in the event, and secured a place at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics. The men's sevens side defended its title for a third straight Games. The mixed-doubles squash pair finished with both gold and silver, a first for that event. Sanda recorded Hong Kong's first Asian Games medal in the discipline, while young sailing and windsurfing athletes won gold on their debut. Karate and the men's track-cycling team event also produced first medals.

Among individual returns, Siobhan Haughey was the delegation's leading athlete, with two individual swimming golds, a silver, and a further silver in a relay, RTHK said. Shen Xiaoyu helped the wushu team to a gold, its first in 16 years, and rower Chiu Hin-chun won his first Asian Games gold. Sailing and windsurfing together accounted for 10 medals, the largest share by sport, with swimming and fencing on six each.

The delegation sent 580 athletes in 38 sports. Basque pelota, wrestling and modern pentathlon were on the Hong Kong programme for the first time, RTHK reported. Track and field and swimming also produced Hong Kong records outside the medal count.

zh.headline: 港隊亞運閉幕合計11金54牌 金銀銅皆歷屆最多
zh.dek: 港台報道，代表團今屆以11金19銀24銅作結，合共54面獎牌，金牌及獎牌總數同為歷屆亞運最佳。
body: 港台報道，名古屋亞運周日作結，中國香港代表團最終取得11金19銀24銅，合共54面獎牌。金牌數目和獎牌總數都是港隊歷屆亞運最好成績。
港台指，今屆有多項港隊紀錄。黃澤林奪得網球男單冠軍，是該項目首面亞運金牌，並取得2028年洛杉磯奧運資格。男子七人欖球隊衛冕成功，連續三屆封王。壁球混合雙打首次包辦金銀牌。武術散打取得亞運獎牌零的突破。帆船及滑浪風帆的年輕運動員首戰亞運便奪金。空手道和場地單車男子團體賽亦首次登上亞運頒獎台。
個人成績方面，港台稱何詩蓓是全隊成績最好的運動員，游泳個人項目兩金一銀，另加接力一面銀牌。沈曉榆協助武術隊相隔16年再奪亞運金牌，賽艇選手趙顯臻則首次在亞運封王。以項目計，帆船連同滑浪風帆共10面獎牌，數量最多；游泳和劍擊各得6面。
港台報道，今屆港隊派出580名運動員，參與38個項目。板網球、摔跤和現代五項是港隊首次參加的亞運項目。田徑和游泳亦有運動員打破香港紀錄。
